source.title: Quantitative metagenomics using a portable protocol
reported_systems: commercial microbial DNA and whole-cell mock communities

calibration.standard: ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community DNA Standard II (Log Distribution), eight bacterial and two fungal strains
calibration.entry_stage: Standard DNA and already-extracted sample DNA receive separate sequencing-library barcodes, then are pooled before cleanup, adapter ligation and sequencing.
calibration.barcode_kind: library/sample partition identifiers; not heritable lineage ancestry tags or independent mutation-event labels
calibration.known_abundance_basis: Paper uses theoretical genome copy numbers for a commercial DNA standard and input DNA amounts; exact lot quantities, composition-to-copy conversion and uncertainty records in the named supplement were not acquired. No independently certified stock counts claimed.
calibration.fit: Barcode-effect normalization and regression of theoretical against observed standard genome copy numbers are reported, then used for sample quantitation.
calibration.measurement_target: Estimated genome copy abundance in extracted DNA, not directly enumerated living cells or independent mutation births.
calibration.observed_copy_definition: Main text reports BEF-normalized mapped bases divided by covered bases; supplement equations not acquired/replayed.
calibration.TMD_conditional_fit_rule: A separate calibration fit can be assessable with identifiable parameters, propagated joint uncertainty, a justified count law and native-context transfer frozen before evaluation. Fitting the evaluation endpoint cannot simultaneously supply its independently frozen predictor.

orthogonal_validation.method: digital PCR on selected genus-level 16S targets with gBlock controls
orthogonal_validation.inference_limit: Agreement on aliquots of the same purified DNA can test downstream quantitation; it does not independently establish whole-cell extraction recovery, viability or mutation-event counts. Gene-copy to genome-copy comparison requires the target/copy-number mapping, which is not replayed here.

stage_limits.potential_downstream_use: Concrete benchmark architecture for DNA-input-to-sequence quantitation and barcode/library efficiency under the tested composition, reference and sequencing conditions.
not_established: pre-extraction cell capture or taxon-specific lysis recovery
physical-cell count from genome copies without copy-number and viability assumptions
native SBW25 mutation births, establishment, extinction or invisible loss
independent biological-trial count from barcode technical partitions
transport of the reported thresholds or calibration to native Wsp/Aws/Mws

reported_detection_criteria.scope: Source-defined LOD/LOQ criteria only; no universal cell detection probability, event-loss bound, TMD threshold or stopping-rule replacement.

resource.completeness: The article reports a 4.78-Gbp validation experiment, while the visible mock-community SRA summary displays 95.4M bases. Different aggregation or processing is possible; the correspondence is unresolved, not evidence of an error or absent files.

source.title: Synthetic DNA spike-in standards for cross-domain absolute quantification of microbiomes by rRNA gene amplicon sequencing
source.source_capture_owner: root watch S04; reused here without a fresh call

calibration.material: Synthetic rRNA operon constructs carried in purified linearized plasmid DNA. The natural bacterial/fungal mock community targets were also cloned rRNA operons in linearized plasmids.
calibration.quantity_basis: Author-reported Quant-iT dsDNA/Qubit mass concentration, defined DNA mixtures and dilutions reported as approximate copy amounts; the precise mass-to-copy conversion and its joint uncertainty have not been replayed.
calibration.sequence_identity_basis: Sanger sequence confirmation establishes construct identity, not a separate absolute input-copy count.
entry_stages: Into already-extracted soil DNA for downstream amplification/sequencing calibration.
In the soil extraction experiment, after cell lysis by bead-beating and before subsequent extraction steps; the broad before-extraction wording must not be interpreted as before lysis.
calibration.measurement_target: Estimated rRNA gene/operon copies per PCR or sample amount (including per mg soil), not direct genomes, viable cells or mutation-origin episodes.
calibration.competitive_control_scope: Standards and natural targets undergo the downstream competitive PCR, sequencing and bioinformatics stages together. Native cell capture/lysis are not challenged by the post-lysis DNA addition.
calibration.reported_validation: Defined plasmid mock mixtures, varied spike-in levels in a fixed soil-DNA input, and varied soil mass with fixed spike-in amount; source results are author-reported, not reanalysed.
calibration.replication: Figure 1 reports three technical replicates; figure panels or all pairwise contrasts are not independent biological units.
calibration.bias_boundary: The source reports discrepancies in absolute load estimates and greater stability of between-sample differences. Primer binding, amplicon length and sequence context may change relative efficiency; native route transfer is not established.
calibration.uncertainty_boundary: No imported numerical calibration or known exact input total. Native use needs input concentration and dilution uncertainty, count/sampling and regression uncertainty, shared-pool/technical dependence, and process/sequence transfer in the joint uncertainty plan.

examples: Lowest bacterial spike-in level omitted because Sc5001/Sc5002 each yielded at most 25 reads per sample.

source_defined_filters.interpretation: These are source-analysis exclusions, not a native detection-probability or invisible-loss bound, and no TMD filtering/stopping rule is adopted.

correction.scope: The acquired correction clarifies the original publication date as 11 February 2025 rather than 17 March 2025. The notice states no methods, numbers or conclusions correction.

TMD_admission.count_law: Reads, gene copies, technical aliquots and pairwise contrasts do not supply an independent founder/culture count law or one-outcome trial ledger.
not_supplied: Native Wsp/Aws/Mws stock and allele-to-route authentication
Viable introduced-lineage denominators, ancestry and inherited-negative controls
Establishment before terminal recovery, missed/lost lineage truth
Independent mutation supply or untouched complete comparator evaluation
TMD_admission.conditional_value: Concrete architecture for checking a DNA-stage quantitative assay and a named public replay resource, conditional on native process matching, identifiable calibration parameters, propagated uncertainty and frozen transfer.
